title: Momentum
description: Just a smoother, smarter way to play. Designed for enhanced performance, reliable updates, with a vanilla look and feel, with some much needed Quality of Life improvements.
body:
# **The Only QOL/Performance Modpack You'll Ever Need**

Skip the lag and the headaches. I’ve put together the ultimate, lightweight modpack featuring handpicked performance and essential quality-of-life mods. Smoother frames, smarter features, same classic game.

## Apart from performance mods, **Quality of Life** mods in this modpack:

1. **3D Skin Layers** - Views Character skin in 3D.
2. **AppleSkin** - Enhances Food/Hunger HUD.
3. **Better Statistics Screen** - Better details in the Statistics Screen.
4. **Continuity** - Better Connected Textures.
5. **Dark Loading Screen** - Enhanced Loading SCreen Customization
6. **Flashback** - Allows in-depth recording of gameplay, with minimal FPS Drain.
7. **Gamma Utils** - Increases brightness in low visibility areas. Highly Configurable.
8. **JourneyMap** (**Disable by pressing F5**) - Adds a Fullscreen and Minimap for enhanced navigation.
9. **LambDynamicLights** - Adds Dynamic Lighting.
10. **Resourcify** - Enables downloading of resource packs, worlds, shaders in-game.
11. **Simple HUD Enhanced** - Adds a hihgly configurable HUG for enhanced info.
12. **Zooomify** - Adds OptiFine's zoom capabilities in Fabric.
13. **Shulker Box Tooltip** - Previews Shulkerboxes in Inventory on mouse hover, skipping the need to place them.
14. **SmoothHUD** - Enhances HUD animations. 
15. **Nemo's Inventory Sorting** - Adds a sorting mechanic which helps organize chests and inventory.

### **The only controversial mod is JourneyMap. Some players prefer them, some do not. I've added it anyway, and it can be toggled off by pressing F5. It disables the minimap.**

All of these mods are **QOL only**, and completely **client side**. They are **non-intrusive**. They can be easily disabled if you do not prefer them. 

I hope this modpack brings upon performance and that you are able to experience Minecraft lag-free and smoothly without any interruptions. Hope you have a great day :)
